tango_rounds.inspection: Actual 38-frame render inspected after fresh preflight. Eligibility gap is visible before closure; K3 closes at zero load; K4-K6 preserve a world-fixed hook seat while root/pelvis retreat and rear support carry the load; K7 visibly returns to zero load while contact remains closed; K8 uses a distinct lift/rotate unseat path; K9 opens a real gap; K10 tool-head lag opposes torso overshoot; K11 settles displaced rather than resetting.

noodle_queen.inspection: The hook/peg silhouette makes the one-way relationship legible without metadata: an ugly little geometric trap that only becomes authoritative when seated. Load, unload, unseat, and release are visually different beats, with enough root consequence and recovery debt to avoid mannequin demo behavior.
